# Hydroelectric Power

Hydroelectric plants generate electricity from the flow of water through turbines.

## Types of Plants

- Impoundment facilities use a dam to store water in a reservoir
- Run-of-river facilities divert part of a river through turbines
- Pumped storage facilities move water between two reservoirs to store energy

## Considerations

Dams can affect river ecosystems and fish migration, so environmental assessments are required before construction.
